name: CardReset
runtimeDependencies: A600 or A1200 with Kickstart 37.300 or later, card.resource and Gayle PCMCIA
notes: Aminet supplies Artur Pogoda’s 26 July 2002 m68k command and its in-archive readme. The separate Aminet index readme has different bytes.
The shared BCWB startup sequence owns the commented Run >NIL: C:CardReset TICKS 50 line.
The command uses card.resource ownership and the Gayle PCMCIA registers. The shipped readme recommends CardPatch. The BlizKick modules are a separate release.
